name: flask
note: holdout2: a second held-out set, written from the source at this commit after the dev and test sets had been used repeatedly. Every question is about a fact none of the twenty questions in eval/questions/flask.json asks about, and none is a rewording of one; six of the ten point at files no earlier question expects. expected_files are paths relative to the repo root; a retrieved record counts as relevant if its file is in the list. Scored once, after the configuration was chosen on dev.

questions.question: How can a view register a function that changes the response for this one request only?

How does a blueprint serve files out of its own static folder?
How do I turn keyword arguments into a JSON response object?
Where can I keep a value so that several functions handling the same request can share it?
Which dotfiles are read to set environment variables before the command line tool runs?
How can a test call a custom command line command and read what it printed?
How are functions that run before and after every request registered?
In the tutorial app, how is one database connection reused for a whole request and then closed?
